a.lede: Despite a $2 trillion valuation ahead of its IPO, Anthropic hasn't been a money-spinning operation so far.
a.title: Anthropic lost $8 billion last year and said its AI could destroy humanity

b.lede: Anthropic has committed $11.6 billion over seven years to Akamai's cloud infrastructure, a bet on CPUs that could grow to about $20 billion, and in an unusual arrangement, Akamai is giving Anthropic a potential stake of up to 5% of its stock that grows as Anthropic spends more.
b.title: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
